user.title: Set up WINNES GPS
user.description: Connect to the WINNES/TKSTAR mytkstar.net tracking backend without storing your tracker password. Enter the internal numeric User ID and Device ID from the GetDevicesByUserID request in your browser's Developer Tools. These are not the IMEI/tracker number printed on the device. See the repository README for the exact privacy-safe steps.

data_description.user_id: Numeric UserID from the GetDevicesByUserID request payload.
data_description.device_id: Numeric DeviceID from the same request payload. Do not enter the tracker IMEI/serial number.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the WINNES tracking backend.
error.device_not_found: The backend did not return the configured device. Check both internal IDs.
error.invalid_response: WINNES returned an unexpected response. The unofficial web API may have changed.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while validating the tracker.

abort.already_configured: This WINNES backend device is already configured.

init.title: WINNES GPS options
init.description: Privacy mode is fail-closed: while enabled, the integration makes no WINNES HTTP requests and publishes no live telemetry. You can also control it from the Privacy mode switch entity.

data_description.privacy_mode: Persistently stop all WINNES polling and clear live tracker telemetry.
